en.title: PlayStation Plus Drops Dead Island 2, Tomb Raider Trilogy for November 2026
en.summary: Sony has unveiled its PlayStation Plus monthly lineup for November 2026, featuring a trio of highly anticipated titles. Subscribers can dive into zombie survival, classic adventure, and strategic card battling.
en.body:
Sony has officially revealed the PlayStation Plus monthly games for November 2026, and it’s a lineup designed to get players hooked right before the holiday season kicks into high gear. Starting November 3rd, PlayStation Plus members across all tiers will gain access to a compelling collection of titles, headlined by the zombie-infested streets of **Dead Island 2**, the remastered adventures of **Tomb Raider IV – VI Remastered**, and the strategic depth of **Monster Train 2**.

This selection offers a significant value proposition for subscribers. **Dead Island 2**, a game that finally emerged after years in development hell, drops players into a gore-soaked, sun-drenched Los Angeles overrun by the undead. Its blend of visceral combat and dark humor has been a hit with fans looking for a satisfying co-op experience. Following that, the **Tomb Raider IV – VI Remastered** collection brings three beloved entries from Lara Croft's early PlayStation adventures to modern hardware. These remasters promise to update the graphics and gameplay of classics like *Tomb Raider: The Last Revelation*, *Tomb Raider Chronicles*, and *Tomb Raider: The Angel of Darkness* for a new generation. Rounding out the core trio is **Monster Train 2**, the sequel to the critically acclaimed deck-building roguelike where players defend their train from waves of enemies across multiple vertical battlefields. The original *Monster Train* was lauded for its innovative mechanics and replayability, making its sequel a highly anticipated addition.

## A Familiar Yet Fresh Lineup

This month's PS Plus offerings seem to prioritize established IPs and well-received genres. The inclusion of **Dead Island 2** and the **Tomb Raider** remasters taps into nostalgia while also providing action-packed experiences. For those who enjoyed the original **Monster Train**, the sequel is a must-play, offering more of the strategic card-based combat that made its predecessor a standout. It’s a smart move from Sony, leveraging the popularity of these franchises to drive PS Plus subscriptions. While the teaser mentioned games from Kojima Productions and Ryu Ga Gotoku, those appear to be from a different, perhaps earlier, month's lineup, as the confirmed November 2026 titles are **Dead Island 2**, **Tomb Raider IV – VI Remastered**, and **Monster Train 2**.

## What This Means for Subscribers

For PlayStation Plus Essential members, this is a fantastic month, offering substantial games that can easily provide dozens of hours of entertainment. The availability of **Dead Island 2** alone is a major draw, and pairing it with classic **Tomb Raider** titles and a promising strategy game like **Monster Train 2** creates a well-rounded package. It’s also worth noting that **Grand Theft Auto 5** remains available for PlayStation Plus Extra and Premium members until November 17th, offering yet another massive open-world experience. This strategy of providing a mix of AAA hits, remastered classics, and engaging indie-style games ensures that there's something for almost every type of gamer within the PlayStation ecosystem.

## What's Next

These November PlayStation Plus titles will be available for download from November 3rd until December 1st, so make sure to claim them before they rotate out. Keep an eye on PlayStation Access for further announcements regarding the December 2026 lineup.

content_raw: November’s lineup of games on PlayStation Plus has been revealed by Sony. Ahead of the holiday season, PlayStation Plus members are getting a wide variety of free games that they can try out on the service, including two big titles from Kojima Productions and Ryu Ga Gotoku. The first game on this list is Death Stranding 2: On the Beach . The sequel to the first Death Stranding game, this follow-up takes eleven months after the events of its predecessor, featuring Sam Porter Bridges and Fragile as they set out across Australia to connect surviving colonies with the Chiral Network. It’s well worth a play, especially with this deal on PS Plus; in our review, IGN’s Simon Cardy scored the game a 9 out of 10 , calling it a “triumphant sequel that emphatically delivers on the promise of its original.” Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii is the second game on this month’s list. Join an amnesiac Goro Majima after he wakes up stranded on an island, gather a crew of pirates, and uncover a hidden treasure in this spinoff of the Yakuza series. It’s a delightfully fun romp, and another title that’s well worth taking advantage of if you’re a PS Plus subscriber; IGN’s Tristan Ogilvie scored the game an 8 out of 10 in our review , calling it “a consistently captivating voyage that kept my timbers shivering whether on land or at sea.” Other games included in this month’s PS Plus lineup are Dragon Quest III HD-2D Remake , a reimagining of the beloved classic that earned a 9 out of 10 from our reviewer, as well as 2025 survival-action game Atomfall , first-person shooter Trepang2 , and racing game MotoGP 26 . Although GTA 6 is likely going to take up the bulk of most players’ time, these titles might make for a good break between heists.
